Who will win this race? Betfair Non-Runner Rule applies. Reduction factors may be updated periodically at the discretion of Betfair based on trading in the market, but after approximately 5 minutes from scheduled ‘off’ time of a given race, they will be updated only in exceptional circumstances. However we will re-settle all bets should the official result at the time of the "weigh-in" announcement differ from any initial settlement. Dead Heat rules apply.
